Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my name on it yet, but you can refer to me as the claimant.
Q: That's fine for now. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at a signalized intersection in Katy, Texas. I was turning left across the oncoming lane.
Q: What was the traffic signal showing when you began your turn?
A: It had turned yellow, and I thought I could make it through. I started to go when the light was still yellow.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I glanced one way, saw nothing close, and then there was a loud bang on the driver's side.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were traveling?
A: Maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour. I was barely moving because I was turning.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They said I had a neck strain. My neck is stiff and I have a headache
when I turn my head.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've been taking a few days off, and I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the pain.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm sorry for the damage and I want to get this resolved fairly for everyone involved.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
